author: CNN
description: James Talarico was seen at the Austin City Limits music festival and a Kacey Musgraves’ concert over the weekend after a 12-day absence from the campaign trail. The Texas Senate Democratic nominee’s campaign said he was getting over the flu. CNN's Jeff Zeleny reports.
title: Talarico shows up at a Kacey Musgraves concert

author: CNN
description: Asked by Jake Tapper about AI job losses, Bill Gates said society will need to decide how to tax AI and robot usage and which jobs to preserve for humans.
title: Bill Gates says we must decide which jobs to reserve for humans

description:
CNN’s Ed Lavandera and team spent 30 straight days inside a rural North Dakota hospital, with rare access to the ER and beyond. They documented the day-to-day reality of keeping a rural hospital running and how immigrant workers are helping fill critical staffing gaps amid the national immigration debate.

Watch the full documentary, The Whole Story with Anderson Cooper: “30 Days Inside: Hospitals and the Immigrant Workforce,” streaming now on the CNN app.

Watch 24/7 live news with CNN Headlines: https://bit.ly/4eIvlTr

#30DaysInside #Immigration #Hospitals
title: Inside a rural North Dakota hospital that serves three states

description:
Fareed Zakaria discusses France’s student protests, debt crisis, and upcoming elections with Sophie Pedder. 



Kim Ghattas explores Middle East conflicts and her new book, The Best Kind of American. Rana Foroohar examines Trump’s Greenland ambitions and growing Arctic tensions.

description: DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin told Jake Tapper he is “sure” footage from ICE agents’ body cameras in the NYC shooting will be made public. He gave no date, saying it will come once the FBI and HSI investigation is complete.
title: DHS Secretary Mullin “sure” ICE bodycam footage will be released

author: CNN
description: Chimney Rock, North Carolina got significant rainfall after the remnants of Isaias move through the area causing flash flooding.
title: Remnants of Isaias bring flooding to North Carolina

author: CNN
description: Pope Leo XIV has announced plans to undergo surgery to remove a localized lung nodule, a small mass of tissue in the lung. CNN’s Christopher Lamb reports on what is known about the Pope’s announcement.
title: Pope Leo announces surgery to remove lung nodule

description:

author: CNN
description: Authorities on Sunday urged villagers along the Budhi Gandaki River in northern central Nepal to move to safer places after a flash flood impacted several houses and infrastructure. There were no immediate reports of casualties.
title: Buildings swept away by flood in Nepal

author: CNN
description: A man officials say is an undocumented immigrant has been injured after being struck by an ICE vehicle in Houston, Texas on Saturday. An ICE spokesperson said the man “ran in front” of the vehicle while attempting to flee after agents tried to conduct a vehicle stop. The man is in a stable condition in hospital with lower-body injuries, officials say.
title: CCTV video shows moment man is struck by ICE vehicle

author: CNN
description: Yemen’s Houthi militants killed at least a dozen people and wounded hundreds of others after launching a strike on King Khalid airport in Saudi Arabia’s capital Riyadh. It was the third attack on the international airport this week.
title: Saudi airport struck three times this week

author: CNN
description: This video shows the final days on Mount Everest of the man behind one of mountaineering’s most enduring mysteries. He died just below the summit in 1996 and was known as only “Green Boots.” But now India has confirmed his identity and is attempting a dangerous mission to bring his remains back.
title: Solving the mystery of ‘Green Boots’ on Mt Everest

author: CNN
description: Sen. Bernie Sanders backed Troy Jackson, the Democratic Senate nominee in Maine's battleground race, at a rally today. CNN's Arlette Saenz reports.
title: Bernie Sanders stumps for Maine Democratic Senate nominee

author: CNN
description: President Donald Trump brought up the idea of renaming the Atlantic Ocean or Pacific Ocean during a rally in Clarksville, Tennessee.
title: 'Trump Ocean' floated as new name for the Pacific or Atlantic Oceans

author: CNN
description: The Portuguese Football Federation has suspended Cristiano Ronaldo for walking out on the team and initiated disciplinary proceedings. CNN's Patrick Snell reports.
title: Portugal suspends Cristiano Ronaldo

author: CNN
description: Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth’s announcement that the execution of the convicted Fort Hood mass shooter would be livestreamed caught people across the Pentagon and the Army off guard, three sources familiar with the matter told CNN. CNN's Haley Britzky reports.
title: Army caught off guard by Hegseth’s call to make execution public

author: CNN
description: Baseball games in Asia offer different experiences for fans than those in the US, with coordinated chants and a wider variety of food options. CNN’s Ivan Watson and Travis Caldwell share stories of watching the game in South Korea.
title: Why is watching a baseball game in Asia so unique?
